title: frasera angustifolia
intro: Frasera angustifolia, commonly known as the Snake Root or Colorado Snakeroot, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Frasera angustifolia include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include iridoid glycosides, such as frasereine and secologanin, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
